items.headline: Chabad of Sunnyvale seeks permit for new worship space
items.summary: Chabad of Sunnyvale is applying for a use permit to operate a religious assembly space inside an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue, which sits in an R-1 residential zone.

items.headline: Nvidia permits $1.66M server rack installation
items.summary: A permit for an R&D Lab use at 300 Holger Way covers a $1,664,913 Nvidia rack installation, pointing to continued buildout of data-center or lab infrastructure at that address.

items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: A new multi-family condo permit for a 5plex at 2820 Florence Avenue was issued at a cost of $1,381,899, adding housing units in that neighborhood.

items.headline: Council weighed potential legal case against fire truck makers
items.summary: The council met in closed session to discuss a potential legal matter involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh Corporation, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association.

items.headline: Council discussed appointing a new city attorney
items.summary: The closed session agenda included a public employee appointment item for the City Attorney position.

items.headline: Council weighs 408-unit housing project on El Camino Real
items.summary: The City Council held a public hearing on annexing and rezoning land at 451-475 El Camino Real to allow construction of 408 residential units, with environmental review completed under state law.

items.headline: Council to discuss Cubberley Site deal with school district
items.summary: The City Council held a closed-session conference with real property negotiators regarding 4000 Middlefield Road, the Cubberley Community Center site, discussing purchase, exchange, and/or lease terms with the Palo Alto Unified School District.
